description: The.338 Lapua Magnum is a rimless, bottlenecked, centerfire rifle cartridge.  It was developed during the 1980s as a high-powered, long-range cartridge for military snipers.  In addition to its military role, it is increasingly used by hunters and civilian long-range shooting enthusiasts.
